_source: IISER Bhopal Central Instrumentation Facility (CIF) Bioimaging facility
name: Laser Scanning Confocal & Fluorescence Lifetime Imaging Microscope
model: TCS SP8 Spectral Confocal with Live-Cell Stage Incubator
specs: Multi-laser excitation (405, 488, 552, 638 nm) with high-sensitivity HyD spectral detectors
Stage-top CO2 and temperature-controlled live-cell chamber for time-lapse organelle tracking
Z-stack 3D reconstruction, FRET, FRAP, and colocalization analysis
useCases: Live-cell organelle-specific dye validation and phototoxicity screening (Luminojen)
Preclinical CAR-T and CAR-Macrophage immune synapse and tumour-spheroid infiltration imaging (Cytoforge Therapeutics)
bookingNotes: Biosafety Level (BSL) clearance required for live mammalian cell imaging.
